links.comparator_used: No head-to-head comparator; descriptive evaluation of edit-rate monitoring (clinical edit intensity validated against clinician gold-standard labels)
links.outcome: Ability of clinician edit-rate metrics to flag clinically meaningful editing and detect changes in editing behavior over time
links.effect: Clinical edit intensity ≥1 had 88.9% PPV for clinically meaningful editing; EWMA control charts detected changes coinciding with system-wide rollout; 268,379 encounters
links.quote: Longitudinal monitoring detected changes coinciding with system-wide rollout.

design_hint: post-deployment monitoring of clinician edits to AI scribe notes
